subject: Sandbox deep-dive: onsite vs remote — scheduling & logistics
messages:
From: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
To: María Gómez <maria.gomez@olivetech.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 7 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox deep-dive: kickoff options + logistics

Hi María,

Thanks again for the interest — really looking forward to the POC. We want to structure the kickoff as a hands-on sandbox deep-dive that covers: prompt review, routing examples, and a short load-test run to validate throughput.

Two quick questions before I lock calendar time:
1) Do you prefer an onsite session at your SF office or a remote workshop? For onsite, we’ll bring two engineers and will need visitor access and a room with HDMI + recording permissions. For remote, we’ll need host screen-sharing and the ability to record (we can provide an attendee link).
2) Any preferred date windows next week? We have availability Wed AM (Jun 9) or Fri AM (Jun 11) PT. If neither works, suggest alternatives and we’ll try to accommodate.

I attached a lightweight agenda for your review and a visitor-access form (if you choose onsite). Once you confirm location and a date window, Stephanie will coordinate room/AV and I’ll send a calendar invite with pre-reads.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
<aisha@redwood.com>

Attachments: sandbox-deepdive-agenda-v1.pdf, visitor-access-form.pdf

From: María Gómez <maria.gomez@olivetech.com>
To: aisha_rahman <aisha@redwood.com>
Cc: infra@olivetech.com
Date: Mon, 8 Jun 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox deep-dive: kickoff options + logistics

Thanks Aisha — this looks great.

Short answers: we’d prefer onsite if possible (team benefits from whiteboarding and we like having folks in the room for routing/playback). We can do Fri AM Jun 11 but our lead infra engineer is traveling that day — would Thu Jun 10 AM work? If you can do Thu AM, I’ll submit visitor access requests today.

Two logistics notes:
- Visitor access at our campus requires a list of attendees + IDs 48 hours in advance. I’ll need the full names of your engineers.
- For the load test, infra will need a list of IPs or ranges to whitelist ahead of time. They’re on cc (infra@olivetech.com) — can you provide that?

Best,
María Gómez
Head of Product Ops, OliveTech
maría.gomez@olivetech.com

- Full names and job titles for the two Redwood engineers attending
- Confirm the room capacity you prefer (small huddle for demo or larger workshop room for breakouts)
- Any NDA or visitor waivers we should sign in advance (upload to the Drive link if needed)

Hi all — quick note from infra. We can support an onsite load test on Thu Jun 10 but we need:
- IP ranges to whitelist at least 24 hours prior (we can accept CIDR ranges)
- A brief runbook of expected concurrent connections / token rates so we can size internal routing for the test

If those aren’t ready, we recommend running the load validation remotely where timing is looser (we can still supervise).

On visitor access: María, please submit visitor names + scanned IDs through our portal; the deadline is Tue Jun 9 5pm PT.

—Infra Team

Aisha
